result.plainSummary: The follow-up puts actual results first and adds honest local screenshot previews while preserving evidence and rerun safeguards.
result.summary: Independent review of SLC-02 and the explicitly confirmed post-seal amendment. Re-read sl-plan-break-spec and security-review boundary guidance, refreshed CLI related pack, and checked SL-003/021/022/031 plus docs/architecture/agent-tools.md and W-011 navigation obligations. Written scope denies remote fetch, escaping paths, invalid image formats and changed bytes; previews use passive session projection and remain observations. Historical capture attribution, missing/attested/failed output, keyboard and narrow-screen evidence, explicit guarded rerun, and workstream rather than invented requirement association are stated. No high-severity spec gaps found. This review approves the bounded plan only.
residualRisks: Implementation should enforce local image containment after symlink resolution and check digest on the same bounded bytes it returns; negative projection tests should confirm denial without writes or network fetch.

Bound both individual images and total projected preview bytes/count so the session response cannot grow without bound; concrete conservative limits are implementation choices within the written bounded-projection scope.
SL-031 currently binds existing UI tests; before completion extend its test command/evidence to cover the new image projection and result-first behavior, plus the specified live browser checks.
The existing screenshot is historical demo evidence; preview labels must not imply a fresh capture of SLC-02 or verification of an individual requirement.
The related CLI provides generic worktree caution text rather than actual sibling paths, so sibling conflict scan coverage is unavailable.
